subject: FLAG-02 directive
notes: kb/Work PB1376 (w1012k). cite.py --check 7.3.14.4 'The implementor shall provide a warning mechanism that flags the incompatibilities potentially affecting existing programs' OK (GR1). The mechanism is the parse-tree pass FlagConformancePass emitting COBOL1620 (Warning) per flagged construct, documented in docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md and docs/CONFORMANCE.md A.1 item 79. Every option's warning is located: the walk-time detectors by the walk cursor, and the one directive-keyed detector (b, a >>TURN known only by its line) through FlagAtLine, which positions the diagnostic at the directive's own line. Before PB1376 the b warning carried no location and two identical unlocated warnings collapsed into one. Per-option population completeness is judged on the GR4 rows. retired-witness: unit:FlagDirectiveTests.Compile_Flag02IoStatus07On_EmitsCobolnet1620_OnEachPhraseSpelling (the same witness, re-spelled when the product's name retired the compiler's first name (kb/Work PB3837: a test name carrying a code spells it COBOL####, kb/Work PB3575); the new spelling is recorded in its place)
